payload.prompt:
Create a Europa Universalis V victory situation Icon DDS asset.
Subject: Create the main Towards Victory situation icon: a six-road victory emblem with a central crown or laurel and six tiny route marks. Use six small route accents in the path theme colors: crimson red, leaf green, gold yellow, ivory white, royal purple, azure blue. Extreme minimalist victory icon: one central symbolic subject, at most 1-2 tiny supporting shapes, strong silhouette, readable at 128px, no text, no letters, no logo, no UI frame, no complex scene.
Reference image: use the uploaded target-specific reference image only as style guidance for palette, brushwork, lighting, surface treatment, and framing discipline. Do not copy its subject, exact composition, silhouette, ornament placement, or any text.
Distinctiveness: keep the result in the same visual family as the reference, but make it visibly different at a glance through changed shape language, object arrangement, cropping, or decorative accents.
Composition: keep the main subject centered, readable, and high-contrast, with no watermark, no letters, no logo, and no UI chrome baked into the art.
Target format: final DDS target is exactly 128x128 and must stay under 100,000 bytes.
Target-specific requirement: Extreme minimalist victory icon: one central symbolic subject, at most 1-2 tiny supporting shapes, strong silhouette, readable at 128px, no text, no letters, no logo, no UI frame, no complex scene.
Style rules:
Match the palette, brush feel, lighting, icon density, and framing discipline of the selected target's reference image. Keep the final subject and asset meaning driven by the selected batch entry, not the reference subject.
Extra composition rules:
Use the reference only as a style guide. Keep the result in the same visual family, but make it visibly distinct at a glance by changing the silhouette, crop, object arrangement, and ornament placement. Do not mirror the reference composition or reuse its exact outline.
Avoid:
busy scene, landscape, many objects, detailed narrative, ornate frame, UI frame, text, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, realistic photo
